openings.claim: Current assignments may misselect historical courses; renames may alter membership or merely recognition.
openings.discriminator: Hold labels constant for reassignment; compare identities and labels for renames.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints in fabricated private staging.
openings.probe: Compare exports against agreed weekly membership for unchanged, reassigned, renamed and split courses; check center boundaries.
openings.uncertainty: Correlation is not causation; historical data and reliable expected sets remain unverified.

openings.claim: Replacement request handling may explain delay; elapsed delay may not increase active handling.
openings.discriminator: Request-to-start latency versus execution; follow-up minutes versus waiting.
openings.probe: During two short sessions, record request/start/completion/receipt and active checking, correction, download, follow-up and import time against logs.
openings.uncertainty: Session realism and timestamp capture effort are unknown.

openings.claim: A confirmed weekly manifest could drive selection and privately reconcile intended/emitted identities, with independent center authorization per participant row.
openings.discriminator: Coverage survives assignment/name changes; confirmation and correction must not consume saved checking time.
openings.fit: Uncertain: private service, unchanged CSV, six engineer-days, existing hosting and concurrent attendance entry are required.
openings.probe: Compare incumbent/manifest exports against independently recorded sets with six coordinators in two sessions; include rename, transfer, empty and split courses. Verify import, zero foreign rows and concurrent entry; stop at budget/hosting limits.
openings.uncertainty: Affordable stable identities, ownership, accurate inexpensive confirmation and nonblocking reads are unverified; splits need explicit child selection.

decision: Probe causes and effort before committing to the manifest. Synthetic observations establish no mechanism; split-center isolation remains untested. Assess the next 40 operational exports against median handling <=12 minutes, intended sets >=95%, and zero foreign-center records.
